## Overview

`lifewatt` maps a US ZIP code to environmental justice indicators:

- residential electricity price estimates (observed EIA-861 annual ZIP-level
  and EIA B1 state monthly series) with YoY / MoM trends;
- bill-as-evidence price views;
- an expected life-expectancy loss view anchored to published national life
  tables (NCHS), with any life-expectancy translation declared as a
  caller-supplied sensitivity parameter;
- a synthetic life-expectancy estimate (state mortality rates + national
  life-table anchor; every assumption declared in `sensitivity_assumption`).

## Workflow

```{r eval = FALSE}
library(lifewatt)

# observed price (ZIP-level annual, customer-weighted)
electricity_price("32601", year = 2024)

# state monthly series (2023-01 .. 2026-07; 2025+ provisional flags)
electricity_price("32601", period = "mom")

# trends
electricity_price_trend("32601", period = "yoy")
electricity_price_trend("32601", period = "mom")

# price + bill evidence (bill is Bayesian evidence, not a required input)
my_electricity("32601", bill = 180, time = "2026-12")
my_electricity("32601", bill = 180, usage = 1200, time = "2026-12")

# expected life-expectancy loss view
expected_life_loss("32601", "2026-07")
expected_life_loss("32601", "2026-12", bill = 180, usage = 1200)
expected_life_loss("32601", "2026-09", delta_le = 0.01)

# adult health estimates for the ZCTA (CDC PLACES 2025 release, BRFSS 2023;
# downloaded live from data.cdc.gov on each call)
health_measure("32601")
health_measure("32601", measure = c("DIABETES", "BPHIGH"))
```

## Provenance and honesty contract

Every returned row carries provenance columns (`source`, `level`,
`degraded_from`, `mapping_vintage`, `provisional`). Prices are state-level
estimates for the utility territory the OpenEI 2024 mapping assigns to the ZIP.
Months from 2025-01 onward are provisional and flagged; months after 2026-07
are served by a validated phase-B triplet forecast (`fit_as_of = 2026-07`).
`health_measure()` is the exception on provenance *epochs* rather than on
columns: it is the only interface that is not served from a shipped snapshot, so
its `provisional` flag is always `FALSE` while the bytes come from a live
query.

`delta_le` is a declared sensitivity parameter, not a sourced elasticity: the
output labels it in a `sensitivity_assumption` column. Without `delta_le` the
life-loss columns are withheld. `life_expectancy()` / `life_expectancy_trend()`
return **synthetic** estimates (mortality-based D1b/D2 sensitivity synthesis);
the `estimate_type` label states they are not NCHS-published subnational life
expectancies, and all synthesis assumptions travel in `sensitivity_assumption`.
The mortality source is quarterly (NCHS VSRR provisional), so trend periods are
`"yoy"` / `"qoq"` — `"mom"` is refused honestly.

```{r eval = FALSE}
life_expectancy("32601")
life_expectancy("32601", quarter = "2024Q4")
life_expectancy_trend("32601", period = "yoy")
```
